entries.venue: Gowans Auctions, Hobart: 2 DOOR POST OFFICE BOX - ORIGINALLY FROM FITZGERALDS IN HOBART (7 bids)
entries.note: Closest local comp: a post office box unit, only 2 doors, from a Hobart shop. Sold $500 hammer on 7 bids, which suggests strong local demand per unit, but a 21-door bank is far larger and heavier and the doors are not necessarily the same C of A type. Description blank, so the type and condition are unknown. Page opened via API (search result data). Premium extra.

entries.note: Post office fit-out timber shelving, not brass doors. Shows post office memorabilia attracts bidders (12 bids). Titles only, no condition. Premium extra.

entries.venue: Gowans Auctions, Hobart: PINE PIGEON HOLES (14 bids)
entries.note: Plain pine pigeon hole unit, no brass doors. Shows the floor for a decorative multi-compartment timber unit, roughly $35 to $240 across 16 Gowans results since Oct 2025 (median $118). Lacks the cast C of A doors so this is a low guide only. Premium extra.
